messages.plaintextBody:
Elena,

Can you confirm the post-money cap table and the price per share? We make it £4.4681 and 12,309,524 new Series C shares for £55m. Want to be sure the option pool top-up to 10% post is reflected before we send to Thornaby.

Priya
